features.title: Extended 900–2500 nm SWIR Sensitivity
features.description: ZephIR™ 2.5e covers 900 to 2500 nm, providing access to an extended SWIR wavelength range. The 2.5 µm upper limit makes the camera suitable for applications where spectral information beyond conventional shorter-wave infrared ranges is required.

features.title: T2SL Focal Plane Array
features.description: The camera uses a T2SL FPA with: 640 × 512 pixels and 15 µm pixel size. The detector provides a scientific imaging platform for extended-SWIR applications.

features.title: Deep TEC Cooling to −80 °C
features.description: At 20 °C ambient, ZephIR™ 2.5e can reach −80 °C using TEC + forced-air cooling. Deep cooling helps reduce unwanted detector noise and supports improved signal acquisition.

features.title: High-Speed Full-Frame Imaging
features.description: ZephIR™ 2.5e provides a frame rate of 240 fps. This supports high-speed SWIR imaging where temporal resolution is important.

features.title: Up to 4000 fps ROI Acquisition
features.description: When imaging only a selected region of interest, the camera can achieve ROI frame rates up to 4000 fps. This provides a higher-speed acquisition option when full-frame imaging is not required.

features.title: High Quantum Efficiency
features.description: The camera has a specified peak quantum efficiency greater than 70%.

features.title: High Operability
features.description: Typical detector operability is specified at greater than 99%.

faqs.question: What is ZephIR™ 2.5e?
faqs.answer: ZephIR™ 2.5e is a deep-cooled SWIR camera from Photon etc. designed for infrared imaging from 900 to 2500 nm.

faqs.question: What wavelength range does ZephIR™ 2.5e cover?
faqs.answer: ZephIR™ 2.5e is sensitive from 900 to 2500 nm.

faqs.question: What type of detector does ZephIR™ 2.5e use?
faqs.answer: The camera uses a T2SL focal plane array with a 640 × 512 pixel format and 15 µm pixel size.

faqs.question: How cold can the ZephIR™ 2.5e detector get?
faqs.answer: At 20 °C ambient, the specified cooling temperature is −80 °C.

faqs.question: What cooling technology does ZephIR™ 2.5e use?
faqs.answer: ZephIR™ 2.5e uses thermoelectric cooling with forced air.

faqs.question: Does ZephIR™ 2.5e require liquid nitrogen?
faqs.answer: No. The manufacturer describes the camera as thermoelectrically cooled and states that it does not require a liquid-nitrogen refrigeration unit.

faqs.question: Does ZephIR™ 2.5e require water cooling?
faqs.answer: No. The supplied manufacturer information states that the camera does not require water cooling.

faqs.question: What is the frame rate of ZephIR™ 2.5e?
faqs.answer: The full-frame frame rate is 240 fps, while ROI frame rates can reach up to 4000 fps.

faqs.question: What is the sensor resolution?
faqs.answer: The ZephIR™ 2.5e uses a 640 × 512 pixel T2SL FPA.

faqs.question: What is the pixel size?
faqs.answer: The pixel size is 15 µm.

faqs.question: Does ZephIR™ 2.5e support external triggering?
faqs.answer: Yes. The camera provides Trigger IN/OUT for external control.

faqs.question: What software is used with ZephIR™ 2.5e?
faqs.answer: The camera can be controlled and analyzed using Photon etc.'s PHySpec™ control and analysis software.

faqs.question: Can ZephIR™ 2.5e be integrated into custom software?
faqs.answer: Yes. Photon etc. provides SDK support for C++ and Python.

faqs.question: What interfaces does ZephIR™ 2.5e support?
faqs.answer: The camera supports USB 3.0 and CameraLink™ computer interfaces.

faqs.question: What image formats are supported?
faqs.answer: ZephIR™ 2.5e supports 16-bit HDF5, FITS and TIFF image formats.

faqs.question: What is the integration time range?
faqs.answer: The specified integration time ranges from 1 µs to the full well capacity.

faqs.question: What is the peak quantum efficiency?
faqs.answer: The specified peak quantum efficiency is greater than 70%.

faqs.question: What is the typical operability of the sensor?
faqs.answer: Typical operability is greater than 99%.

faqs.question: What are the dimensions of ZephIR™ 2.5e?
faqs.answer: The camera measures 169 × 130 × 97 mm.

faqs.question: How much does ZephIR™ 2.5e weigh?
faqs.answer: The camera weighs 2.9 kg.

longForm.heroHook: Deep-Cooled SWIR Imaging from 900 to 2500 nm
longForm.heroLead: High-speed, deep-cooled SWIR imaging for demanding scientific experiments and industrial applications. Photon etc. ZephIR™ 2.5e is a deep-cooled short-wave infrared (SWIR) camera sensitive from 900 to 2500 nm. Its T2SL focal plane array, deep thermoelectric cooling and low-noise operation are designed to help acquire weak infrared signals with improved signal quality. The camera uses a 640 × 512 pixel sensor with 15 µm pixels and provides frame rates up to 240 fps, with ROI frame rates up to 4000 fps. ZephIR™ 2.5e uses TEC + forced-air cooling and can reach a cooling temperature of −80 °C at 20 °C ambient, without requiring water cooling or liquid-nitrogen refrigeration. For system integration, the camera supports USB 3.0 and CameraLink™, external trigger input/output, and Photon etc.'s PHySpec™ control and analysis software. Developers can also use the supplied C++ and Python SDK.

sections.title: Why Deep-Cooled SWIR Imaging?
body: Improve signal quality for demanding infrared measurements
Infrared detectors generate unwanted signals that can interfere with the measurement of weak infrared features.
ZephIR™ 2.5e uses deep thermoelectric cooling to reduce unwanted detector noise.
At 20 °C ambient, the camera can reach a cooling temperature of −80 °C using TEC + forced-air cooling.
According to Photon etc., this deep cooling allows the camera to acquire more signal and minimize unwanted noise for a given imaging application.
